title: Command Substitution
story: $( ) runs a command and pastes its output into your line. It turns commands into values.
goal: Count the lines in notes.txt and print: notes.txt has N lines
starter: # wc -l < file prints a line count
hints: Run wc -l < notes.txt inside $( ) and keep it in a variable.
socratic: Why use < notes.txt instead of passing the file name to wc?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Command Substitution”?
